We've been working on voter registration since we were founded in 2020, folks.
Amidst a global pandemic, we came together to advocate for mail-in ballots, register new voters, and educate everyone on how easy mail-in voting was. We succeeded beyond our wildest expectations.
So we stepped it up for 2022. Our focus was on eligible non-voters in Nevada, a key state for voter access, and helped drive tens of thousands of disengaged citizens to register to vote and participate in our elections with many key statewide races on the ballot, including Governor, Senator, Secretary of State, and Attorney General.
With our democracy and our right to vote threatened again , we have no choice but to respond and push harder. If the president can step aside for the sake of our country, the least we can do is honor that sacrifice by driving pro-democracy voters to the polls.

We must make 2024 our biggest voter registration campaign yet. With so many states voting under new maps, court-appointed maps, and new laws -- our voter education campaigns have never been so necessary.
California, North Carolina, and New York have changes to their voting laws this year. South Carolina has had confusion about their voting map. North Carolina, Louisiana, and New York are among the states with new congressional districts. Wisconsin has all new (and fair!) state maps.
The list goes on, but the mission is clear: Register new voters, educate about election law changes, and turn out pro-voting advocates to make sure everyone's voice is heard in our elections. Our country is depending on us.

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: We are at a critical point
body:
We must defend our nation’s founding documents and principles of liberty through education.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zorrsrung966eiralvd1l6795v5ue3ue0fj1sfu8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2chim9o36clh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I hope you’re having a great day. There’s something important I want to share with you today. For years, we’ve seen a growing effort from radical activists to destroy the principles of liberty that have made our nation the freest and most prosperous in history. These radicals have found a willing ally in the Biden administration’s education department. And right now—with the help of these government bureaucrats—they are actively denigrating the U.S. Constitution in America’s schools while teaching destructive ideologies like **critical race theory** and **socialism**. We are at a key point in our history. We **must** defend our nation’s founding documents and principles of liberty through education. And that’s why I’m emailing you today.
---
| | Hillsdale College recently produced a limited number of DVD box sets of our very popular **“Constitution 101”** online course, and I’d like you to have a copy. The course features Hillsdale’s faculty—the same professors who teach our required course on the Constitution on campus. And when you view **“Constitution 101,”** you’ll learn about:
* The original design and purpose of the Constitution.
* The challenges it faced during the Civil War.
* How it has been undermined for over a century by progressivism and liberalism.
* How limited government under the Constitution might be revived in our own time.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqkctivokt8a6bi72egojancq1iocq2aiddng5n0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2chim9o36clh2bs)
---
| | **Right now, it can be yours when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more. You can take advantage of this limited-time offer using this secure link:** _[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/constitution-101-dvd/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1f6is20et5im47kbd7u3fd5q30kh67vg801tao8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2chim9o36clh2bs)_ And when you do, you’ll not only get your own DVD box set, but you’ll help expand our national educational outreach efforts such as free online courses, classical K-12 education curriculums, and _Imprimis_ —our digest of liberty. We need your support because we REFUSE all government funding, even indirectly in the form of student grants or loans. **So, please reserve your DVD box set with a gift of $100 or more using this secure link:** [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/constitution-101-dvd/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkv2l0u6rhu5itkj22nei48re2pln614dvvai44g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2chim9o36clh2bs) And remember, as I mentioned above, supplies are limited, so be sure to reserve your copy today. body:

Dear Fellow American, I hope you’re having a great day. There’s something important I want to share with you today. For years, we’ve seen a growing effort from radical activists to destroy the principles of liberty that have made our nation the freest and most prosperous in history. These radicals have found a willing ally in the Biden administration’s education department. And right now—with the help of these government bureaucrats—they are actively denigrating the U.S. Constitution in America’s schools while teaching destructive ideologies like **critical race theory** and **socialism**. We are at a key point in our history. We **must** defend our nation’s founding documents and principles of liberty through education. And that’s why I’m emailing you today.
---
| | Hillsdale College recently produced a limited number of DVD box sets of our very popular **“Constitution 101”** online course, and I’d like you to have a copy. The course features Hillsdale’s faculty—the same professors who teach our required course on the Constitution on campus. And when you view **“Constitution 101,”** you’ll learn about:
* The original design and purpose of the Constitution.
* The challenges it faced during the Civil War.
* How it has been undermined for over a century by progressivism and liberalism.
* How limited government under the Constitution might be revived in our own time.

body:
We must defend our nation's founding documents and principles of liberty through education.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=93a174bf753e4d209fdeaf8339b7ff7a&_e=XI4hvKRrug9VcxMLRwabTgqa9hiN-VGPGW1YFfH5IO9NQUjngf-QclyvSSw5kjum8_UHhnAJnM0JY1Ek766Km5Ir5M6t_JEb-X84D1PQ6aCyCoI2tnpf9h1j953ESghLx4N46RysXiXLZLGTCdDI0tDcAmBDiu97jqR1bGT5tajb43nJD2VtR1h0WLbKq_BCgCXFUyXrMYKNqTYMS9MGf_M6mndrJMUfyQGpV1ZgRIKFs7B2-Tv2Zzw-be5-GQ1skhzdq-AXHHscomvfcttzfTD4jfkDneTaI14T_--u7dm-lP_xdCGkagy2emP0FYrx5HBpSv3VUil75bIUT0O01QsbbXXaSzlj6mKQDkBDtuxmeIt9VKWl6S-fVA3uzZnh6-z2mRQiVl8A0i0XUz-R1Q%3D%3D)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I hope you're having a great day. There's something important I want to share with you today. For years, we've seen a growing effort from radical activists to destroy the principles of liberty that have made our nation the freest and most prosperous in history. These radicals have found a willing ally in the Biden administration's education department. And right now--with the help of these government bureaucrats--they are actively denigrating the U.S. Constitution in America's schools while teaching destructive ideologies like **critical race theory** and **socialism**. We are at a key point in our history. We **must** defend our nation's founding documents and principles of liberty through education. And that's why I'm emailing you today.
---
| | Hillsdale College recently produced a limited number of DVD box sets of our very popular **" Constitution 101"** online course, and I'd like you to have a copy. The course features Hillsdale's faculty--the same professors who teach our required course on the Constitution on campus. And when you view **" Constitution 101,"** you'll learn about:
* The original design and purpose of the Constitution.
* The challenges it faced during the Civil War.
* How it has been undermined for over a century by progressivism and liberalism.

name: Senator Rand Paul
subject: This petition will make them go ballistic
body:
It's a win-win scenario

Dear Concerned American,

Your petition to Senate Minority Leader Mitch
McConnell, House Speaker Johnson, your Senators, and your
Congressman is linked below.

It's vital that you submit your petition
immediately.

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, the
Biden/Harris Administration, and the Big Labor bosses are about
to go ballistic.

I have introduced the National Right to Work
Act to repeal forever Big Labor's power to force workers to pay
union dues in order to work.

So the union lobbyists, Chuck Schumer, Hakeem
Jeffries, and their allies are going to use every trick in the
book to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

And they want to do it as quietly as
possible.

The union kingpins (and their water-carriers
in Congress) can't afford the consequences of having their
coercive privileges publicly debated and voted on in Congress!

They don't want the American people to know
that:

*** Millions of workers are forced to
surrender part of every paycheck to keep their jobs.

This cash funds violent "organizing" drives,
a limousine lifestyle for union bigwigs, and bankrolls radical,
tax-and-spend politicians like Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and
Hakeem Jeffries.
*** Big Labor's power is deadly to millions
of small businesses.

Big Labor politicians and stacked bureaucrats
are strangling small businesses with confiscatory taxes,
destructive laws, and straitjacket regulations.
*** Forced unionism exports millions of good
jobs overseas.

Productivity-killing work rules, workplace
class warfare, slowdowns, "sick-outs," and strikes all take their
crippling toll, closing the doors of many businesses -- for good.
In the fight to force votes on a National
Right to Work law, opponents of forced unionism will face a
showdown against the full might of Big Labor.

That's why it's vital that you act at once to
ignite massive public support for a National Right to Work Bill.

Now is the time to act.

By the time the Right to Work Bill comes up
for a vote, every member of Congress must realize the eyes of the
American people will be watching.

National opinion polls all show that 80% of
the American people agree it's wrong to force workers to pay
union dues under the threat of being fired if they don't pay!

And the National Right to Work Committee, who
has led the fight against forced dues for over 50 years, must
have your help in demonstrating that to Congress.

If the public's attention is fixed on this
battle, Congress will be forced to recognize -- or defy to its
peril -- the massive public opposition to compulsory unionism.

Then we'll see who dares to stand with Big
Labor. . .

. . . and who stands with freedom and the
American people.

It's vital you click to submit your petition
to Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators,
and your Congressman immediately to demonstrate to Congress and
the national media the strong support for Right to Work.

It's all part of the National Right to Work
Committee's four-part plan to pass a National Right to Work law:

*** Contact directly by mail up to 10 million
supporters, urging them to demand their Senators and Congressmen
vote for the National Right to Work Bill;
*** Brief personally the hundreds of
favorable columnists, radio talk show hosts, and editorial
writers nationwide who can help mobilize public opinion;
*** Deploy digital advertising through email
and across social media in the days before the vote to really
make Congress feel the heat; and
*** Run TV and radio ads targeting swing
votes in key states and districts.
It is critical in this battle that Congress
hears loud and clear from the nearly 80% of Americans who support
Right to Work.

Of course, Congress may choose to obey Big
Labor bosses rather than the majority of their constituents.
That's their choice.

But time and again, when politicians defied
the public and voted for forced unionism, they've paid the price
with the end of their political careers!

Of course, this whole effort will be very
expensive.

An all-out media and direct-mail blitz to
mobilize massive public pressure on Congress will be the key to
our success.

To pay for the expensive ads, mailings, and
other efforts, it's urgent you send a special contribution to the
National Right to Work Committee today.

Will you make a generous contribution of
$200, $100, $50, $25, or $15 to launch the next, crucial phase
for ultimate passage of a National Right to Work law?

It's vital you act immediately to put the
politicians' feet to the fire to bring the National Right to Work
Act up for a vote.

It would be a crime to let politicians who
support compulsory unionism off the hook.

Up against the forced-dues fed,
billion-dollar might of Big Labor, all the Committee has on its
side is truth, public opinion. . .

. . . and you!

Unlike Big Labor, the National Right to Work
Committee doesn't have (or want) the power to force anyone to pay
dues.

So it has to depend on generous folks like
you.

Please don't make it easy for Chuck Schumer,
Hakeem Jeffries, the Biden/Harris Administration, and Big Labor
to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

Some folks have already sent $100, $200, and
even more. For others, a contribution of $25 or $50 has been as
much as they could afford.

Please submit your petition so we can
demonstrate to Congress and the media the strong support for
Right to Work.

Without your contribution of $200, $100,
$50, $25, or $15, the National Right to Work Committee won't be
able to contact 10 million Americans, place the advertising,
deploy the whole digital program, or do anything else to put Big
Labor on the spot with a public vote on the National Right to
Work Bill.

And if you and I don't press forward now, we
may never have a chance like this again.

Please help today.

Be sure to submit your petition to Senate
Minority Leader Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your
Senators, and Congressman, and then pitch in with your
contribution of $200, $100, $50, $25, or $15 to the National
Right to Work Committee.

Sincerely,

Rand Paul
United States Senator

P.S. Since most Americans oppose Big Labor's
forced-unionism powers, a public debate on my National Right to
Work Bill is Big Labor's (and their water-carriers' in Congress)
worst nightmare!

So please, submit your petition to Congress,
and then pitch in with your contribution of $200, $100, $50, $25,
or $15 to the National Right to Work Committee today.

The National Right to Work Committee is a
nonprofit, nonpartisan, single-purpose citizens' organization
dedicated to combating compulsory unionism through an aggressive
program designed to mobilize public opposition to compulsory
unionism and, at the same time, enlist public support for Right
to Work legislation. The Committee's mailing address is 8001
Braddock Road, Springfield, Virginia 22160. The Committee can be
contacted toll-free at 1-800-325-7892. Its web address is
www.nrtwc.org

Not produced or e-mailed at taxpayer expense.

To help the National Right to Work Committee
grow, please forward this to a friend.

## Deadly Missile Attack Hits Israel
At least 11 teens and young adults [were killed on Saturday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFy3CAQQL8GdXsjVpw4FRRxoSbjtClv1rAcmyBwgJzG-fqMU6d6xave-_56fyXJUh7f6GA3Yr2TH_LkuwW8AZq7mYKLzMjLxE5bRG0NGj0lZxeD9naN13XRmlivEbfVL34j8xb1xpM4nNHMFm96nrXZLnO04YbXzaxr4GULyswcZNR2-VGljMQxf9Qnt4uvx5RdGuO9q-WLwl3hfp7n5ejl0yncucDvrnAvfH7irC0HhXviP281Z0qQZHSQ3ogznDISBKaQhfsAGoP8T5ACRy0jdci1PMDXErP4ARIidPro0Ei6lAdEptahRuDuKdOQWhTu1ODlRf_6el3a1Fx4PyVn6atVZn4cJPlfxPj_0qfDvwEAAP__-HZ7gQ), and dozens injured, in the deadliest attack on Israelis since the start of the war in October. Israel blamed Hezbollah for the missile attack on a soccer field packed with children in the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights. A Hezbollah spokesman [denied "any relation"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAUAL8GtljweDEwMHTxlq4dLQwPmwqbyEa20q-v0rnbSSeddF-P8eFzydv86VdyLdXRh5ZPGvUNzA1wRB5dIgJSnJzUAFIjoOSLI49kFBov0XifprvVAiEocZ9UEnbi2YEAFBqMFEKi7UTS0cDdYt9HUjYyFBRzq3v3XfPWFkrlVU_au1BXXtzS2vNg6oPBwGC4rqubpvB2DIaNroPB4PeWQ6E3BrDxFX8MbnPlu4vPK5eSj14zFPPqc_mrtv8fTwe_AQAA__9EVlLR) to the attack. The strike comes amid [reports that Israel delivered an updated ceasefire proposal](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuhDAQRL_G7kD2smBcuEhDd2lTos15gY3M-QQWJPn6iNTXjEYaaZ7ex228kSR5zO-0cihTHule5ODRVdBXgCPqGCZm4EZzsA7AOgS0egkuokFqbGvNp596MA346CN16DzZFrUEMIDGQW-NsehrM7nYQ-ux6yI3Pio0HKXkrf7K8igLT-knH7zV97zqFJZSnrtq3hQMCobzPGv6lrxfq4Lh-lYwGHf1K2TfiFM10y9VS94LzVxFpqS3EJ-npCR75xSaeSVJ_4jyWvgI8BcAAP__hhpVJQ) to the U.S. during Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's U.S. visit. Netanyahu's office said he was returning home as quickly as possible after the attack.
## Crash Kills Members of Popular Gospel Group
Three members of The Nelons, a popular gospel music family from Atlanta, were [killed in a plane crash](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOtDAMBOCnCR0oGIOhSPE36fZvr0TZxCw5hWRFcot4-xPUV9nFJ81ovh7zw_jg4-u_2ViVJc3GFv_hmWoYa8AZK6cWZuCuYtUSQEsI2FarwoGe6J7SytGRtdTT0g-LdQbM1I09VV6BBJQEYytli1MjF3Ij9BMOg-NucgIlO1_S3nwnH8vKSzjTh_fGpq0Kai3lnUX3T4AWoI_jaH6yKcmZ8wICdC5pPwXoyEe-jik-RQH6ihWgJV0_3SCkmOt3MJFru5u81seZNh9fAjRhTxKol7evduXehw_B54EEytdmfLgLlb_n-Sj4DQAA__9XxGRV) in Wyoming Friday. The group was on their way to the Gaither Homecoming Cruise in Alaska, along with four others who were also killed. The crash is under investigation, with few details currently known. Anchored by husband-and-wife duo Jason and Kelly Nelon Clark, [the Grammy-nominated group](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FurDAQQNGvsbtF42GMoXDxGrp9bUpk8HiZyOAVWKD8fZTU6a-udD6e0zNIlv31P2zsaypTWKpcPLkH9g-kiXT0iRm51eyNQzSOkIxevcMU5wBzXOxiZyDu2SyWYYg2pcEGLR4BCRz2BsDQ0EBysUc7UNdFboeoCDhKLUfzWWSvK6f8VS4-mqVsOvu11vep2n8KR4Xjfd9NXXnnXPbzp1A4zlL04eP7lpzl7JwieG1B8u-g_s25PH4HAAD__3owTSI) includes their two daughters, Amber Kistler and Autumn Streetman. Streetman was the only group member not on the plane.

#
Friend of Life,

My name is Lila Rose, and I'm the founder and president of Live Action.

I'm reaching out with an urgent and heartfelt request. This month, Live Action is partnering with pro-life pregnancy resource centers nationwide to provide onesies for mothers and babies in need. Will you join us for our first-ever onesie drive?

This month only, a gift of $60 will provide three custom "Wonderfully Made" onesies to three moms and their babies at risk of abortion. These onesies are more than just clothing--they are symbols of hope and reminders that every child is a precious gift, beautifully and wonderfully made. [ ](http://trk.libertyledger.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MjE2Mjk1NiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MjEwLTVmY2NjNGViZGI4NzQwYTc5MDA0ZDYxMTFkZmNhNDQ5IiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2dpdmUubGl2ZWFjdGlvbi5vcmcvc2VuZC1hLW9uZXNpZS10b2RheS8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1vbmVzaWUmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Z2VuZXJpY19BRS1MTE81MjI4OSJ9/vpUmZUdJeOW8_rQ3aLMYXg)
Onesies are a basic necessity for every baby. More than that, they symbolize the love and care each new life needs to thrive--a tangible representation of personal connection and love for both mother and baby. For mothers facing unplanned pregnancies or struggling with financial difficulties, having the basics provided can make all the difference in helping them feel supported.

Every baby is a gift that deserves to be cherished and provided for, and every mother deserves to know her baby is treasured not just by her but also by her community.

Abortion providers like Planned Parenthood rely on women feeling isolated by their unplanned pregnancies. Together, we can show these courageous women they are supported and loved by a community that values every life.

To make this possible, you can donate $60 to send custom onesies to three moms and babies in need. Click here to donate: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-onesie-today/](http://trk.libertyledger.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MjE2Mjk1NiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MjEwLTVmY2NjNGViZGI4NzQwYTc5MDA0ZDYxMTFkZmNhNDQ5IiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjIiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2dpdmUubGl2ZWFjdGlvbi5vcmcvc2VuZC1hLW9uZXNpZS10b2RheS8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1vbmVzaWUmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Z2VuZXJpY19BRS1MTE81MjI4OSJ9/jjczVcfvoH0tQK3IJ_6MKw)**

If you can, please share this email with friends and family who might also want to help or share our campaign on social media to raise awareness.

Thank you for stepping up to support mothers and their precious children. With your help, we can make a profound difference in these families' lives.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**
Live Action

_P.S. Remember, this campaign only runs until the end of the month! clean_body: This race isn’t over | | | | | Fellow American, I've played in lots of double-headers. And that's exactly what you and I have on our hands here. A one-on-one matchup with Adam Schiff on November 5th. You see, Adam Schiff's enablers in the corporate media are already spreading the lie that this race is over. They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: Be careful what you wish for. I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you! | | | | Steve Garvey #6 | | | | | PAID FOR BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE PO Box 532389 Los Angeles, CA 90053-2389 |

name: Jill Stein
subject: Lies, lies, lies, and more lies.

body:
Did you miss my email about Bibi's spech?

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bibi_liar_resend_7_27&n=1)
---
Peter,

Thursday I sent you an email about Netanyahu's speech last Wednesday and I wanted to make sure you had a chance to read it. We knew what to expect when Netanyahu walked in that chamber. Every word of his speech was laced with the same tired lies that have been repeatedly debunked for the last 10 months – and the last 76 years.

At least 40,000 Palestinians are confirmed dead and experts estimate the final death toll will be as high as 186,000. Hundreds of thousands more have been gravely injured, including children who have had to get their limbs amputated _without anesthesia_ because Israel is blockading medical supplies and destroying health infrastructure.

_Yet Netanyahu claimed that civilian casualties were “practically none.”

_ Israel has continuously blocked aid from entering Gaza, shutting down access points and slow-walking aid with “security checks.” Israeli protesters have been caught on camera multiple times destroying food trucks. For months experts have warned that Gaza is descending into famine, and shocking photos emerged of emaciated children that looked identical to images of Jewish prisoners in Nazi concentration camps.

_Yet Netanyahu claimed that if Gaza isn’t getting enough food “it’s because Hamas is stealing it.”

_ Israel has sabotaged or walked away from multiple ceasefire negotiations, repeatedly rejecting proposals that Hamas accepted which included every key provision – such as returning all remaining hostages – that Israel says they want. They’ve resisted calls for even a _temporary ceasefire_ to allow for the process of peace.

_Yet Netanyahu claimed that it is Hamas that doesn’t want a ceasefire._
### **Lies, lies, lies, and more lies.**
[**Benjamin Netanyahu is an unrepentant liar, a mass murderer, and a war criminal. He has no business addressing Congress. He belongs in the Hague. If you agree, then donate to our campaign and take this demand to the ballot box in November.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bibi_liar_resend_7_27&n=2)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bibi_liar_resend_7_27&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bibi_liar_resend_7_27&n=3)
---
Even here on our own soil, about our own people, Netanyahu refuses to tell the truth. He perpetuated the dangerous lie that non-violent protesters “stand with Hamas” and are funded by Iran.

Well I stood with those protesters outside of Congress last week, and his lies will never be loud enough to drown out our demands for justice for Palestine.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bibi_liar_resend_7_27&n=4)
---
While we marched outside and demanded justice, the vast majority of the members of Congress – from BOTH of the corporate parties – gave this genocidal monster a hero’s welcome.

**Let’s stop to remember exactly what they’re clapping for.
** (content warning, wounded children) Some of these images are disturbing, and I often hesitate to share them. But we need to bear witness here and never let our elected representatives forget what they’ve done.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bibi_liar_resend_7_27&n=5)
---
The faces shown here should haunt all of our dreams – especially those welcoming their murderer with raucous applause.

Vice President Kamala Harris (now the presumptive Democratic nominee) has issued a statement condemning our protest and spreading dangerous propaganda that threatens the very fundamentals of protected speech.

In it, she showed her true colors. After days of glowing coverage that Harris would be “better on Gaza” than our current president, she revealed her allegiance with Israeli propaganda by repeating Netanyahu’s talking points.

The election has radically transformed in the space of a few days, but as Joe Biden once famously said, nothing has fundamentally changed.

Ours is still the ONLY campaign that will be on the ballot for the majority of voters that vigorously opposes genocide, empire, and endless militarism.

**[Millions of voters are now tuning in to the race again and looking for who best represents them. I need your help to make certain they find our movement. Please give what you can today to support our efforts.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bibi_liar_resend_7_27&n=6)**

We will NOT stop until Palestine is free. As Gaza goes, we all go.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

subject: UD conceals federal fund misspending + more local stories
body:
News + editorial to start your week | Broad + Liberty Weekly Reads | | | |
---
| | | Good morning and welcome to _Broad + Liberty_ 's Weekly Reads.

[Subscribe to our daily email list](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=490c5e913e&e=b7b3eddce2) and get the best of _Broad + Liberty_ delivered straight to your inbox.

### **1.[Upper Darby concealed misspending information from resident; HUD handed it over](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9f1f189a79&e=b7b3eddce2)**
_By Brad Vasoli_
When Upper Darby resident John DeMasi sought information in late May on a federal probe of township misspending, the township demurred. This month, when he turned to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, the agency let him see the documents. The contrasting responses from the state and federal governments underscore issues Upper Darby has contended with in light of the HUD revelations. Among those issues is transparency — or lack thereof. The information the township withheld from DeMasi included the May 14 HUD report that Broad + Liberty obtained via its own federal Freedom of Information Act request. That letter detailed Upper Darby’s misspending of $40,000 in federal funds. On July 8, this outlet[ reported](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6c8795e937&e=b7b3eddce2) on the improper expenditures of money from HUD’s Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program.
**Why It Matters. **CDBG funds typically go toward such activities as public-facility improvements and housing assistance. Last year, the use of the grants for holiday toy giveaways caught the attention of Councilwoman Laura Wentz, a former Democrat who is now an independent. She felt that providing holiday gifts, food and other items to poor families was a worthy cause but she raised objections over how the township and Men of Action Brothers of Faith (MOABOF), a nonprofit then run by Brown, administered the giveaways. Wentz questioned the municipality spending about $6,000 on toys for the 2021 holiday event, complaining that the purchases were improperly documented. She also took issue with a Target receipt for a $153 hoverboard, a much larger expenditure than most of the other toys, most of which cost between $10 and $20 each. The councilwoman also said she found it irregular that the township bought the items and sought reimbursement on behalf of a nonprofit rather than CBDG reimbursing the organization. In her opinion, township officials exploited the holiday charity efforts for “political purposes.”
**Quotable.** “It does appear that the new mayor was getting all these benefits and all the Township Council members that signed on were using this giveaway in their political propaganda saying, ‘Look at what we’re doing; we’re all supporting this,’” DeMasi said. “So, yeah, that’s absolutely political.”
**[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1179f38838&e=b7b3eddce2)**
---
|
---
|
### **2.[Deception, hypocrisy, and failure](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b8dd777de0&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Guy Ciarrocchi_
Biden lied about his health. Harris defended his lies, told her own lies, and attacked anyone who challenged the lies. When they could no longer effectively lie to us — Americans had seen and heard too much — when Democrat donors and left-wing activists realized that Biden was no longer useful to them because he couldn’t win, and when the oligarchy feared he would cause them to lose the Senate and the House, they worked feverishly through leaks, pressure and tweets to get rid of him. Finally, he was left alone with his family and a handful of loyalists. Like the final hours of a banana republic dictator awaiting word that it’s time to leave the palace ahead of the coup. **Why It Matters. **Kamala Harris is as blameworthy as him and his team — even more so. Biden’s statement is filled with deception after deception — including hiding the reason he’s not running for re-election. Biden tragically built his career and ran his campaigns misleading us — with a false biography, misleading economic data, and a “mistaken” family history, including anecdotes he stole from British candidates. He couldn’t even be honest as he steps aside from running. Kamala Harris not only told the same lies and created the same failed record, but she defended his deception. Moreover, she attacked anyone who challenged their false narrative.

**[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7c681e8218&e=b7b3eddce2)**
---
|
---
|

* [Top Election Predictor Weighs in on 2024 Winner](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5e1a955a25&e=b7b3eddce2) | _Voices of Reason_ – A Podcast by PoliticsPA

* **[Ben Mannes: Secret Service hearing showcases a national decline in law enforcement quality](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=337126e7f7&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Robertson + D’Orsie: Generation Z needs school choice](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2c22781ad0&e=b7b3eddce2)**

* **[Andy Bloom: Another fine mess](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a1699e0b0e&e=b7b3eddce2)**

|
# **5\. What we're reading**
The stock markets aren’t great this week (don’t look at your 401k!) but the oldest investment is doing fine: gold! [Suzy Weiss at the _Free Press_ looks at the new-old trend](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c1bf9f1f24&e=b7b3eddce2). They’ve even got gold at Costco now! How much are people buying? Hard to say. “The first rule of gold is never to tell anyone how much gold you have,” Ephraim Rinsky tells Weis. “The second rule is never tell anyone where your gold is.”

Hi folks,

Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re reaching out today because we’re just **100 days** away from the most competitive election of our lives in the two most competitive Senate campaigns in the country.

And we need your help.

Montana and Ohio are the only battleground states in the country that won’t see a lot of spending from the top of the ticket. You see, we’re a little different. We’re not the typical politicians you’d expect to see every day in the Senate. One of us is a seven-fingered dirt farmer. The other has been called disheveled, wrinkled, and rumpled. Neither of us are winning any best dressed awards anytime soon.

**But the thing that really sets us apart? We’ll work with anyone to get the job done for our constituents.** And we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home.

But our multi-millionaire opponents are trying to buy our Senate seats. Together, we’re going to send them a message: Montana and Ohio are NOT for sale.

We can’t write our campaigns million dollar checks. But we’ve got something better: You. Our supporters are teachers, electricians, farmers, autoworkers, you name it — who work hard every day to make a living and together, we can make a difference.

We’re building the largest on-the-ground grassroots campaign either state has ever seen because we won’t win this race unless we knock every door and talk to every voter.

We’re not the typical politicians you’d expect to see every day in the Senate. One of us is a seven-fingered dirt farmer. The other has been called disheveled, wrinkled, and rumpled. And we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home. But our multi-millionaire opponents are trying to buy our Senate seats. clean_body: Despite us polling dead even, or even slightly ahead of Jon Tester, he’s outraising us at a clip we may never be able to match | Fellow American, this Montana Senate race will be the most expensive per vote in the country. We've known this for some time. We can't afford to keep falling behind, or we may never catch up. At this critical moment in the race, we are down more than 2-1 to Jon Tester in fundraising, and we can't afford to make cuts to any part of our campaign operation. I need your help keeping my ads on the air, supporting my travel across the state to meet with Montanans, and, most importantly, reaching out to every eligible voter in our state. We cannot count on Democrat enthusiasm slowing at any point in this race. We simply have to match it or risk defeat. I'm in this race to bring my battle-tested leadership to Washington to fight for our shared American values. I know I can make a difference in the U.S. Senate. name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: 100 days until Election Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
Can I count on you to help me protect our Senate and democracy from right-wing extremism?
| | |
---
Hi there, friend, it's Debbie. I have an important update for you: **Today marks 100 days until Election Day. **

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1701%2E135344%2Ek73IzQ)

Friend,
I want to share a story about someone who, more than anyone, taught me the importance of listening and accountability.
It’s Barack Obama.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240728-1-900&t=2&akid=1701%2E135344%2Ek73IzQ)
I was in the White House the first day he took office in 2009, serving as a part of his national security staff. I staffed his meetings in the Situation Room and briefed him in the Oval Office. Later, I was honored to be nominated by him to serve in the Pentagon.
Despite his effortless charm in public, President Obama was a very tough boss. I don’t think I’ve ever had a tougher boss than President Obama. He’s brilliant, and he’s got a lawyer’s training where he’ll grill you with difficult questions, one after another.
I learned pretty quickly to be prepared, because he was going to make sure you knew your stuff.
What’s more, he was going to hold you accountable to what you said. If you told him a fact or a plan, you’d better deliver on it. If you didn’t know something, you should say that and not try to fudge your way through it. That’s exactly the approach I try to take in Congress. I try my best to know the details, make thoughtful decisions, and be transparent about what I know and don’t know. Because I’ll never forget the lesson President Obama taught me: you better say what you mean, and mean what you say.
[**That’s the kind of Senator I’ll be. And I’m building a grassroots movement in that same spirit to bring accountability to the U.S. Senate. With that in mind, will you chip in$3 to help us get there?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240728-1-900&t=3&akid=1701%2E135344%2Ek73IzQ)

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Two pure toss-ups in Montana and Ohio
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
We must win these two seats to keep our Senate majority.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2287%2E4032634%2EQZ1AJg)
---
My colleagues Senator Jon Tester of Montana and Senator Sherrod Brown of Ohio are running in two of this year’s most critical — and competitive — U.S. Senate elections. And I’ll just be blunt: out of all the Democratic senators up for re-election, they are the GOP’s top targets. They’re the only Senate Democrats running for re-election in states that Trump won twice. They’re neck-and-neck in the polls against multi-millionaire Republicans who’ve poured millions of dollars into their campaigns. And they’re up against millions more in outside spending from right-wing Super PACs. Now, Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown have won tough elections before, and they can win again — but only with strong grassroots support. [**To hold onto our Democratic U.S. Senate majority and hold off Donald Trump’s extreme Project 2025 agenda, we must re-elect Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown. Will you split a contribution between our three campaigns today? $5 or whatever you can contribute would go a long way.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2535?amount=5&t=8&akid=2287%2E4032634%2EQZ1AJg) If we re-elect Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown, they will keep making us proud. Jon Tester is a champion for Montanans and working families in Congress. He’s tough as nails, he’s got a heart bigger than the state of Montana, and he centers every decision on the needs of working people — because he understands those needs down to his bones. He’s the only working farmer in the Senate, and he and his wife, Sharla, work on the same land that his grandparents tended more than 100 years ago. Recently, he led the effort to pass the PACT Act, which provides care and benefits to service members exposed to toxins, and he’s working to make sure the law delivers results. And Sherrod Brown fights from the heart for working people in Ohio and across the country. He grew up in Mansfield, Ohio, in a community of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians, spending summers working on his family's farm. He’s seen manufacturing jobs shipped overseas because of trade deals benefiting giant corporations. And he’s dedicated his life to fighting for the dignity of work. As Chair of the Banking Committee, he takes on big banks and fights to make our economy work for everyone, not just Wall Street CEOs. Both of these races are pure toss-ups — and they are set to decide whether we can ensure the right to an abortion, protect Social Security and Medicare, and put Washington on the side of the people. [**If it makes sense for you right now, please split a donation of any amount between Jon Tester, Sherrod Brown, and me to help defend our majority.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2535?t=9&akid=2287%2E4032634%2EQZ1AJg) Thanks for being part of this, Elizabeth

Look, my life's story is not what the liberal media & Democrat mob claims conservatives should be. I represent EVERYTHING they hate the most.

Fellow American,

I'm Tim Sheehy. Those are also my pronouns. _**SHEE – He.**_

**That's a joke** , but it shows the lunacy we're living with in Joe Biden and Jon Tester's America.

I'm a former Navy SEAL. My wife is a Marine. I led Americans in the battle to defend our country. Then, we came home to live the American Dream in Montana.

We started an aerial firefighting business in our barn. We created hundreds of jobs and protected our public lands and Montanans from devastating wildfires.

I fight fires, so take it from me: the world is on fire under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris.

Consider their disgraceful retreat from Afghanistan. Joe and Kamala let our enemies steal our equipment—and kill 13 heroic American servicemembers.

_[**I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Montana to beat Jon Tester, the liberal Washington politician who supports Biden and Laffin' Kamala every time it matters.** ](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=8691d2b6dc9c4d5b836924172d452338&_e=tAH83niNSFBR7bjEIvqbaJwFRQcSsQDK0v3kQEqhsajpC7YLwCF6gct3n8H0NgUCCXFNKy-uDLVl8xHcKuHxk_L3pVvqZrn0VdCo26VZoVoHJ8h2ptcpAmONPJQ0zNzqw_Il2x0ZJh5OpUaaQKKBq3HI45bjsYf5PEw9MGvjKQDb5AuhZ5Irf-mPu4WsZ7Mc7Nbws5zS81i82a89L-jq0O3kqkVxTa1r_js92Cybx-XYVF7_BpUGjQAAnDime7Q-5jrrQPjGXnD-t20qEF7dDey9NMnDfn1iXXZlc6Je_8IHiIm8Tu8HY0YpWmjrzpdX6QzYiCBZpjTLacursa9qyobljfbTRDsvYYqB5to813y4JK41B0nKnh6Zmw3KfiW1ZIfjRTexiG5uc6lG2Jyyug%3D%3D)_

Jon Tester is the deciding vote for the Left's America Last agenda. He got an F from the NRA. He voted to put a liberal judge on the Supreme Court who couldn't define what a woman is. He even drives a Prius in D.C.

[**SUPPORT TIM SHEEHY TODAY**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=8691d2b6dc9c4d5b836924172d452338&_e=tAH83niNSFBR7bjEIvqbaJwFRQcSsQDK0v3kQEqhsajpC7YLwCF6gct3n8H0NgUCCXFNKy-uDLVl8xHcKuHxk_L3pVvqZrn0VdCo26VZoVoHJ8h2ptcpAmONPJQ0zNzqw_Il2x0ZJh5OpUaaQKKBq3HI45bjsYf5PEw9MGvjKQDb5AuhZ5Irf-mPu4WsZ7Mc7Nbws5zS81i82a89L-jq0O3kqkVxTa1r_js92Cybx-XYVF7_BpUGjQAAnDime7Q-5JS7aZicRIUPGFeOn5Y-dCVg10YbI75sI54LxVnrubQD9Aly967QRjAMbiK6_FdPl3Q7VQ1U8ewPb7qXwnoasrczvUZ7MO4U5hiPDUg0H-CiUA_tXCZfJq9D3Ly6XDBvaIg20mMV_2Mdw3ng4nPzkw%3D%3D)
Jon Tester doesn't represent Montanans. He's a rubber stamp for Biden and Kamala's failed policies. It's time to retire them all.

Listen, I'm an optimist. If you're not, you can't jump out of planes at night into enemy territory.

_I believe America's future will be better than our past._

What Montanans think is common sense is pretty simple: They want a secure border, safe streets, and cheap gas. They think cops are good, criminals are bad, boys are boys, and girls are girls.

July 28, 2024
Dr. Michael Goldstein has been endorsed by "[Stand for Health Freedom](https://substack.com/redirect/24db2e5a-217f-41df-87c1-6b58e1265eca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" an organization fighting high health care costs and loss of patient choices.

Why?
Because this organization understands the reasons behind skyrocketing health care costs in Fairfield County - forced consolidation of doctors by venture capital groups, insurance companies and hospitals. This has resulted in an army of bureaucrats and administrators making huge salaries while sitting in front of computers and harassing doctors with endless pre-approval forms for permission of sick patients to receive medications, diagnostic tests and specialty referrals.
Below is Dr. Goldstein's recent interview (shortened for clarity) by Greenwich reporter Scott Benjamin detailing solutions.
# **Consolidated health-care market drives up costs**
Posted Fri, Apr 26, 2024
By Scott Benjamin
GREENWICH - If you go to buy a Zegna suit at Richards of Greenwich, or walk the sidewalks near Total Mortgage Arena in Bridgeport, or the farms in Oxford or the corporate headquarters in Shelton, Michael Goldstein says voters are concerned about soaring health care costs.
Goldstein said that according to figures discussed at the Greenwich Representative Town Meeting, a body that he serves on, the typical family there spends $39,000 a year on their health care insurance plan.
So, if George W. Bush signed the Medicare reform package with the prescription drug coverage for non-hospitalized senior citizens in 2003, which updated Lyndon Johnson's program of 1965 . . . If Barack Obama approved the Affordable Care Act in 2010 - something that had been discussed since Harry Truman's administration in 1945. . . If Joe Biden signed legislation in 2022 to cap out-of-pocket costs for insulin for senior citizens and saved money on 47 drugs covered by Medicare, which the Democrats had been clamoring for since at least the 2006 midterms . . . Then why are health care costs still soaring?
"A lot of it has been related to regulation and health care consolidation. We have seen the disappearance of private practitioners," commented Goldstein, a longtime Greenwich resident.
He insisted that the anti-trust laws need to be reformed.
"[It has resulted from] The mergers and acquisitions of community-based hospitals and private practices," Goldstein explained in an interview with Patch.com. "[There also have been] Venture capital acquisitions of practices."
"Everything in health care is related to market share," remarked Goldstein, who served as president for the New York County Medical Society for two terms. "A large hospital system gets paid more from an insurance company than individual practitioners for doing exactly the same thing. As health care systems consolidate, prices go up."
Goldstein said that the increased "regulatory compliance" has forced physicians to spend "20 hours a week putting data into a computer instead of treating patients."
He estimates that deregulation could trim $1 trillion a year nationally in health care costs.

| | **Kean Brings IDF Soldier, Scotch Plains Native as Guest to Netanyahu Address**
---
| | This week, Tom attended Prime Minister of Israel Benjamin Netanyahu's Joint Address to Congress. His special guest was Scotch Plains native, Dylan Redfield. Dylan is a member of the Israeli Defense Forces, and has served two years with the IDF after graduating from the University of Maryland. He is currently an IDF reservist. Wednesday's remarks, along with Tom and Dylan's attendance, underscores that the Kean for Congress team will always stand against rising anti-semitism across New Jersey and the United States. We must continue to support our greatest ally in the Middle East, stand up to pro-Hamas agitators, and provide Israel with the tools they need to defeat terrorism. Please thank Dylan for his bravery and determination in securing a better world for Jewish residents at home and abroad. _"There were times while I was serving in the IDF in Israel when I looked back at the news from New Jersey and saw my Congressman showing his unwavering support for Israel. It gave me hope to continue serving in the IDF. It is an absolute honor to be here in Washington, DC, where there is so much interconnected significance, and watching the Prime Minister address a Joint Session of Congress truly meant a lot to me.” _
**_\- Dylan Redfield_**

**Tom Kean Jr.** is the proud husband to Rhonda, and the proud father to two daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful town of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom’s dedication and commitment to public service was inspired at a young age by his grandfather who served in the U.S. House of Representatives, and his father who served as Governor of New Jersey. Throughout Tom’s life, he has followed in their footsteps while setting forth his own path of public service—now serving as a first-term **Congressman for New Jersey’s 7th District.** **_Kean's mission is simple:_**** For New Jersey. subject: Two years ago, Josh Hawley failed veterans like me

body:
This is a story about the burn pit I lived next to in Iraq — and what happened when I got home.
#
Peter — two years ago, Josh Hawley and 40 other Republicans blocked a bill to expand healthcare to millions of veterans like me who were exposed to toxic burn pits during their service.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61382?refcode=em20240728-7170&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7170%2E614464%2EF3K4I3)
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[make your first donation of any amount toward my grassroots campaign to replace Hawley in the U.S. Senate.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61382?refcode=em20240728-7170&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7170%2E614464%2EF3K4I3) But first, I want to tell you about the burn pit I lived next to in Iraq — and how politicians like him failed veterans like me.**
**[ADD DONATION NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61382?refcode=em20240728-7170&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7170%2E614464%2EF3K4I3)**
It was 2009. I was stationed at the Al Taqaddum Airbase where I was a Marine Captain leading a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman. Running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi.
It was my first of three tours of duty during the War on Terror. And from our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61382?refcode=em20240728-7170&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7170%2E614464%2EF3K4I3)
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
For me, that was planning our routes and poring over intel to avoid the immediate danger: IEDs on all the convoys and missions we were running outside the wire. I was so proud to bring every member of that team home safely.
**Or so I thought — because, as it turns out, we couldn’t protect ourselves from our own country.**
When I got back from Iraq, I developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic. They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits. Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
So imagine how we all felt, watching all these Republicans like Josh Hawley, most of whom have never even worn the uniform, throw us a giant middle finger? I know that’s harsh language, but it has to be. Because what they did was about as anti-American as it gets. Patriots don’t attack veterans who suffered injuries or illness from being around those toxic pits.
Many of these same Republicans spent years voting to keep us in these forever wars, lying to the American people about what was really going on over there, and getting rich off their defense contractor stocks that skyrocket when we’re at war.
These people profited off of sending us over there only to screw us when we came back messed up. **It’s criminal — and I’m ready to do something about it.**
I served my country for 13 years in the United States Marine Corps. I’d give anything for this country — and that’s exactly why I’m running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
**We deserve leaders who are willing to make even an ounce of the sacrifice our veterans have.[If you’re with me, please add a donation of $10 or anything at all to my grassroots campaign today so we can stay on track with our goals this month, get this message in front of Missouri voters, and defeat Josh Hawley this November.**](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61382?refcode=em20240728-7170&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7170%2E614464%2EF3K4I3)
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61383?refcode=em20240728-7170&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=6&akid=7170%2E614464%2EF3K4I3) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61383?refcode=em20240728-7170&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=7&akid=7170%2E614464%2EF3K4I3) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61383?refcode=em20240728-7170&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=8&akid=7170%2E614464%2EF3K4I3) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61383?refcode=em20240728-7170&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=9&akid=7170%2E614464%2EF3K4I3) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61382?refcode=em20240728-7170&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=10&akid=7170%2E614464%2EF3K4I3) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61382?refcode=em20240728-7170&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=11&akid=7170%2E614464%2EF3K4I3) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61382?refcode=em20240728-7170&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=12&akid=7170%2E614464%2EF3K4I3)

name: Kirsten Gillibrand
subject: 100 days until Election Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
| | |
---
Hi friend, it's Kirsten. I have an important update for you: **Today marks 100 days until Election Day. **
This means we’re closer to protecting our Senate majority, the White House and, ultimately, our democracy. But I won’t lie to you, friend: The stakes have never been higher.
What happens on Election Day will determine the fate of our nation. And with the GOP continuing to attack our personal freedoms, it remains absolutely critical for us to do everything we can to defend our Senate majority from right-wing extremism.

That's why I’m fighting in the Senate so we can certify the Equal Rights Amendment and restore reproductive rights nationwide, protect and expand Social Security and Medicare, prevent gun violence and keep our communities safe, lower the cost of living and win meaningful change for hardworking families in New York and across the United States.
But here's the bad news, friend: Republicans had historic victories in New York in 2022, and now, they're targeting my seat for defeat.

**I'm a strong believer that grassroots activism matters. | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb6675171-6250-412a-815c-3c7bec5960e0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | | | Peter, I have served this country my entire life. Now that I’ve retired from the US Army as a Brigadier General, I’m ready to continue my service in a new arena. I live in the Georgia district currently represented by Marjorie Taylor Greene. I think my neighbors deserve better. Over the course of 40 years in the armed forces, I served our country in various capacities, including as an infantry commander in Afghanistan following the tragic events of 9/11. I ultimately worked as a senior military advisor at military posts around the world. That means I was providing strategic guidance and leadership to keep our nation strong against foreign adversaries. I took an oath to protect the US Constitution from all enemies, foreign AND domestic. When I left the Army to start my farm here in North Georgia, I discovered that my country still needed me. The current US Congress is the weakest, most chaotic legislature in my memory, and my district is right at the heart of it. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdd6eb023-f7cc-452b-9060-6c41b281c0e0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) I think Georgia deserves better than Marjorie Taylor Greene. I think America deserves better than Marjorie Taylor Greene. My background on both the enlisted and officer side of the armed forces has prepared me to address the complex challenges facing our nation today. That starts with core American values we are severely lacking from some of our elected officials today.
---
|
---

| I’m taking on MTG so we can bring sanity back to Washington. We don’t need chaos and childish tantrums from our elected officials, we need basic, steady leadership. I find that the people I talk to mostly agree: we need better, we deserve better, and it’s time to replace Marjorie Taylor Greene with someone focused on what’s best for America rather than what’s best for herself. [**If you also agree that MTG needs to be defeated, I’m asking for your help.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb42f1454-f3d2-4834-94ba-653b9f884278/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Friend, **Cori Bush is a leader in our ceasefire movement.** Her opponent’s campaign is supported by millions of dollars in far-right ant-Palestinian AIPAC money. **Cori is a leader on reproductive justice.** Her opponent ran the political campaign of an anti-abortion extremist, and anti-abortion Republicans are now backing his campaign to sell out St. Louis. **We can’t let them win.** **That’s why my campaign team is headed to St. Louis this week to campaign for Cori.** Her election is just 9 days away and she’s locked in a neck-and-neck race. body:
#
Peter,
We know it’s early on a Sunday, but we need to ask for your support, so we wanted to quickly share **three reasons** your contribution — particularly today — is so important.
1. Today marks _**100 days until Election Day.** That means we’re _running out of time_ to reach voters with our pro-choice message. _

2. Kamala Harris’s candidacy has brought a wave of enthusiasm and excitement among Democrats, particularly here in California._We need to _seize the moment_ and take advantage of that enthusiasm. _

Since the beginning of the race, my opponent has raised $43.7 million to my $13.7 million. In a state with a little more than one million residents, his campaign war chest will go a very, very long way. This is an emergency donation request. I know we're asking a lot from you, but consider what life will be like if we win the presidency but fail to flip the Senate. I'm amazed, but not surprised, by the amount of cash Democrats are sending Jon Tester, and I wonder how we will compete. Every reputable political forecaster rates this race a TOSSUP, meaning Jon Tester and I have a 50/50 shot at winning this seat. He failed, increasing the incarceration of Black women. Now, as AIPAC and Bell’s Republican megadonors are spending millions of dollars spreading Bell’s lies, I wanted to give Michael Brown’s family the opportunity to set the record straight. Our new TV spot, featuring Michael Brown Sr. and his daughter, gives a voice to those most harmed by Bell’s lies. By supporting this spot, we can continue to be a voice for justice and give St. Louis the platform it deserves. clean_body: This week, I released my final ad in our race against Wesley Bell, our AIPAC-backed opponent. | | | Peter, This week, I released my final ad in our race against Wesley Bell, our AIPAC-backed opponent. I wanted to use this final ad to give a platform to Michael Brown’s family to share their continued pursuit for accountability for their son’s death. My opponent made them promises and when he was elected, he broke them. But we can’t stop fighting for Michael Brown. On August 9, 2014, Mike Brown was killed by a white police officer in Ferguson, MO, sparking a national movement to protect Black lives. As an ordained pastor and registered nurse, I was on the front lines, caring for injured protesters and bridging divides within our community. For more than 400 days, I stood with Michael Brown Jr.'s parents. And took their fight to Congress to demand systemic change. Wesley Bell promised he would bring justice for Michael Brown Sr. and his family. Bell never did, leaving the entire Brown family feeling more than disappointed; they feel lied to. Wesley was also elected by the people of St. Louis because he promised to reform the Prosecutor’s office. He failed, increasing the incarceration of Black women. Now, as AIPAC and Bell’s Republican megadonors are spending millions of dollars spreading Bell’s lies, I wanted to give Michael Brown’s family the opportunity to set the record straight. Our new TV spot, featuring Michael Brown Sr. and his daughter, gives a voice to those most harmed by Bell’s lies. I was elected to be St. Louis’ Congresswoman to give a platform to those hurt by our broken systems. By supporting this spot, we can continue to be a voice for justice and give St. Louis the platform it deserves. With just over a week until Election Day, Bell is attempting to sell out St. Louis, as he lies about his record as a prosecutor, his time in Ferguson, and what people who are truly seeking justice have been able to accomplish in St. Louis, without his help. We must show that AIPAC and their right-wing megadonors cannot buy a Congressional seat in St. Louis. With your help, we can be the change Mike Brown's memory calls us to be. In solidarity, Congresswoman Cori Bush Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If you received this email as a forward and want to get the latest updates from the Working Families Party directly, The Working Families Party is the party of the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that cares for all of us. body:
No matter the pressure brought upon us by AIPAC and their Republican megadonors, we will continue to fight.
#
Peter,
Cori Bush is a nurse, community organizer, and a mother who did not hesitate to speak truth to power in her first week in Congress. Our Squad is more than just members of Congress. It’s part of an extension of a movement that doesn't only want Congress to look like us, but to also be connected to the pain on the ground. name: Tina for Oregon
subject: It’s 100 days to Election Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Tina Kotek
body:
Tina may not be on the ballot this year, but our work for a progressive Oregon absolutely is. |
#
---
Peter, we have just 100 days left until the general election on November 5th. With the Republican National Convention over, it’s clearer than ever that the GOP stands for Trump’s extreme agenda. If Republicans gain control of the White House, Congress, or the Oregon Legislature, they’d put the interests of corporate CEOs ahead of the needs of working people and our planet. There’s a lot riding on the results of November’s election – and we _need_ to keep making progress. **To do that, Team Tina needs to have the resources necessary to communicate with our communities and get out the vote for champions for this work.** Governor Kotek has delivered meaningful results to address the housing crisis, protect abortion access, improve mental health and addiction care, invest in early literacy, and protect the environment. But we can’t let up now. We have 100 days left to make a difference in this election by reaching out to voters across Oregon to ensure we get out the vote. clean_body: Not on our watch. | We’re officially 100 days out from the most consequential election of our lifetime for climate action. The stakes couldn’t be higher: We either defeat Donald Trump and his fossil fuel allies up and down the ballot, or we face a world where we allow corporate greed to run rampant while the climate crisis escalates to global climate catastrophe. = The climate crisis needs to be top of mind for voters this November. Monday was the hottest day ever recorded in human history, beating the record set just the day before. Meanwhile, Donald Trump is doubling down on his promise to "drill, baby, drill," and at the RNC, he vowed to shut down funding for a transition to green energy, calling it a "Green New scam." Then, he and J.D. Vance went on Fox News and spread lies about wind turbines, claiming that wind energy is a hoax. = But this isn’t just rhetoric. Project 2025 offers a step-by-playbook on how to dismantle our environmental protections and bolster fossil fuels. If Trump wins in November, he will gut the EPA, ramp up oil drilling, give MAGA Republican state officials (many of whom are allies of Big Oil) power over regulation of polluting industries, and so much more. And just to underline how deep in Big Oil’s pockets Trump is, look at his Vice Presidential pick: J.D. Vance. Vance has a history of shilling for fossil fuel interests. He is one of the top recipients of oil and gas money, a vocal supporter of fracking, and has said he doesn’t believe climate change is a threat. This duo is poised to push us into a full-scale climate catastrophe. We can’t allow it to happen. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = = = = = = We have 100 days to get this done. Here’s a brief rundown of what we’re up against in this race:
* **Extremist super PACs** that have been spending huge amounts to attack me because they want to replace me with a candidate who will support a national abortion ban.

* **Speaker Mike Johnson** _personally wiring_ money to my opponent, because he knows flipping this district is the pathway to hanging onto his razor-thin, four-seat House majority.

* **A Kansas Republican Party** that has publicly stated their goal is to block abortion, IVF access, Medicaid expansion, and same-sex marriage here in Kansas — _and that sees me as the biggest obstacle to their agenda, since I’m our state’s only elected Democrat at the federal level._

I know my team and I have been a little more aggressive than usual this week when it comes to these emails, and I’m sorry to bug you on a Sunday.
But this is why. Given all the challenges we’re facing — and the stakes of this race when it comes to the direction of the country — I hope you can understand why we have to work as hard as we are to meet our fundraising goal this weekend.
**One last thing: all the groups working to defeat me, including my opponent and his campaign, are acting like I should be afraid of running on my record. But they’re wrong. I’m proud of all we’ve accomplished together.**
I’m proud of our work to lower prescription drug costs, tackle climate change, reduce gun violence, and create good-paying clean-energy jobs here in Kansas.
I’m proud of delivering funds for vital infrastructure projects here in our state — to provide folks here with cleaner water, better roads, and more reliable broadband access.
And I’m proud to be absolutely steadfast in my support for abortion rights — and my opposition to my colleagues’ attempts to ban abortion nationwide, and IVF along with it.

name: Yassamin Ansari
subject: Are you sick of these emails yet?
body:
We wouldn't blame you
Peter, I know that we... I have personally reached out a lot during the final week of this campaign. I promise, it's for good reason, and I'm very grateful for your support and patience. Every dollar we've raised has helped us maximize our mobilization efforts. I can't tell you how many people have thanked us for reminding them to get their ballots in.
Please know, your support, every ounce of it, is making a difference in our race.
Here's what happens though. Every time we raise money and get more ballots in, it lets my team know how much more we can accomplish with each dollar we bring in. It's all informative, and they're constantly updating me on what we can do with a final fundraising boost.
During our pre-canvassing check-in today, Pasquale and Jordyn let me know that another $7,000 will help us expand and optimize our ride to the polls program for Election Day. Here in Phoenix, plenty of people don't have access to their own transportation and in this heat, waiting for the bus or other forms of public transit can be completely out of the question for some.
That's why we're pushing a big ride to the polls program, to make sure everyone can make their voice heard on Tuesday.
Can you make a contribution today to help take our ride to the polls program to the next level? body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Derek,
July has been one of the most momentous months in American political history.
We’ve witnessed a tragic attempted political assassination.
Far-right extremist JD Vance elevated as Donald Trump’s running mate.
A divisive Republican convention that was chock-full of angry rhetoric, but short on policy solutions for the American people.
President Biden following in George Washington’s footsteps in voluntarily choosing not to seek re-election this November — a selfless act that cements his legacy as a true patriot and public servant.
And Vice President Kamala Harris winning widespread support to become the presumptive nominee of the Democratic Party.
All of that in the month of July!
Between now and November, things are going to keep moving quickly — and we have a lot of work to do.
I’m running for re-election to the U.S. Senate because I’ve made it my life’s mission to stand up for Virginia. I’m running to help Democrats keep control of the Senate majority. And I’m running to make sure Virginia’s 13 electoral votes go to our next president, Kamala Harris.
The grassroots support that has surged into our campaign, into Kamala’s campaign, and into Democratic campaigns all around the country during July has been nothing short of phenomenal — if you’ve had a chance to step up and pitch in to a candidate you believe in, THANK YOU! Your support is so, so important to this work — it simply can’t be done without you.
But alongside our own grassroots surge, the GOP has seen a massive influx of support, too — both for the Trump-Vance campaign and for my opponent Hung Cao.
So today, with exactly 100 days left until Election Day, I’ve set a goal of raising $100,000 more before the end of July — and I’m asking you to help us get there. Will you pitch in $25 or more today, so I can keep fighting for a blue Virginia in 2024 and beyond? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

DONATE OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
So much is happening in the news, and I appreciate you remaining focused on the hard work we need to do out in the field, talking to voters and mobilizing Democratic support.
Winning in Virginia could spell the difference between control of the Senate, the Presidency, and a future worth fighting for .
Thank you,
Tim Kaine

Derek, I'm running to defeat Ted Cruz and become the first ever Black Senator from Texas. If you’re already with me, **[will you make a split donation to me and John Fetterman to help power my grassroots campaign? →](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240728?refcode=em20240728-9246&refcode2=9246_434096_NMryNv&akid=9246%2E434096%2ENMryNv)**

All the way back in 1870, Hiram Rhodes Revels, a pastor and State Senator from Mississippi, was elected as the first Black US Senator. Since then, we've come a long way as a country. **But representation – like our democracy – is a work in progress, and I believe we can do better.**
Black Americans have long faced _far too many_ obstacles like: discrimination, lower pay, higher job instability – not to mention the racist voter suppression laws that Texas Republicans like Ted Cruz have championed, which make it harder for certain folks to vote.
**The bottom line is this: It's essential that our government reflects the people it represents.**
I'm ready to defeat Ted Cruz this November and fight to build a more perfect union for my boys and every kid in Texas. But unlike Ted Cruz, I don't have corporate special interests footing the bill for my campaign.
**To win, I need a massive movement of grassroots supporters to step up and join me in this fight.[Please, will you donate to me and John Fetterman to power my campaign to defeat Ted Cruz, become the first Black Senator from Texas, and be the leader Texans deserve? →](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240728?refcode=em20240728-9246&refcode2=9246_434096_NMryNv&akid=9246%2E434096%2ENMryNv)**

I'm so grateful to have you fighting with me.
– Colin

| _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=6999f4c38c1f4dd59f73a8d53783edab&_t=ULojUE3x0c19DA36Ap_322EyCHPxVQn7jyST8Azbfeko6vFLL2ZRAzQvaCRWdiEh0bpX6wXlUNfzhpVKAvEbv5S6BNaKVx_HniYLdoN0o95s48VDkbLzWJvys8ec4qdx)_
