[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=6999f4c38c1f4dd59f73a8d53783edab&_e=4k_iIblMVmvbeM3r0eBsaqe2uQjs2nX41TYcEwoS0v-0Chn6zbRWKUrEsUxWISuoJ9tHPyxk9UnbegHK9ElufMLYmEhVSYoP876jb71_9gqyxDT1LyURrUQB0dxchGI7Ao8pD1B1R4X8MD7TvCNRgi-ael8DOEmpDhWQistIOnzZ2hnwKGCkkH1MTDd_shhqXC-XAmCimkXBH0s8wJsyrKXyE-HeL2-ZDCkfudOnoCO_dKr0Rgac8UVTk0SYQenSKtgzxJ5E70LLuPACo1eOxuy90BNYUWjVkgFDOJdiTERszZL5dWUkgxahZqR_XvGU64m4QrREFjSKGVu-azhZISQo7IMPbfeuANl69x_BVN6SOFlumQBFgBkbJOdQ_VdH)
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=6999f4c38c1f4dd59f73a8d53783edab&_e=4k_iIblMVmvbeM3r0eBsaqe2uQjs2nX41TYcEwoS0v-0Chn6zbRWKUrEsUxWISuoJ9tHPyxk9UnbegHK9ElufMLYmEhVSYoP876jb71_9gqyxDT1LyURrUQB0dxchGI7Ao8pD1B1R4X8MD7TvCNRgi-ael8DOEmpDhWQistIOnzZ2hnwKGCkkH1MTDd_shhqXC-XAmCimkXBH0s8wJsyrMgm-uZ0FU0NRvwN4PXAdxdUEwTC0ho2Aa2An7ixSRVZO_Ws1dHO8Og5bDdVs0exJbh4Gs3QH2Gm87Tywmg-lKGx36sxFPXn_DGdJMwL7YCD4MUcLOo805ltPtnzc6U1wzdedrVEVlgYXuPtv8TDkLOpErMS3mCxVhwlaoEZv1pu8WLdWNUqxhK0uGqBbTbljw%3D%3D)

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey has only eight questions, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
* Hides the corruption of the ruling class
* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=6999f4c38c1f4dd59f73a8d53783edab&_e=4k_iIblMVmvbeM3r0eBsaqe2uQjs2nX41TYcEwoS0v-0Chn6zbRWKUrEsUxWISuoJ9tHPyxk9UnbegHK9ElufMLYmEhVSYoP876jb71_9gqyxDT1LyURrUQB0dxchGI7Ao8pD1B1R4X8MD7TvCNRgi-ael8DOEmpDhWQistIOnzZ2hnwKGCkkH1MTDd_shhqXC-XAmCimkXBH0s8wJsyrMgm-uZ0FU0NRvwN4PXAdxcMSYOFypGNfPSAk05SSkAg2pCptJ9d8vlZk9zr0lrSNaeJvXFYfVSccDNcJGpPE7IZoCjRmczTLLhXaoXZlQuUUEo5BPLkC6ls2QJ-IPv2WFP7T9h6qR3jzVANDBczhitKMuz8OZX2unF9W673r9mz-JOk2iH1We6UFyK8TtYjtg%3D%3D)**

The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.**

Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack.

**You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.**

A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

These efforts include:

* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It only has eight questions and will take a few minutes of your time.

Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=6999f4c38c1f4dd59f73a8d53783edab&_e=4k_iIblMVmvbeM3r0eBsaqe2uQjs2nX41TYcEwoS0v-0Chn6zbRWKUrEsUxWISuoJ9tHPyxk9UnbegHK9ElufMLYmEhVSYoP876jb71_9gqyxDT1LyURrUQB0dxchGI7Ao8pD1B1R4X8MD7TvCNRgi-ael8DOEmpDhWQistIOnzZ2hnwKGCkkH1MTDd_shhqXC-XAmCimkXBH0s8wJsyrMgm-uZ0FU0NRvwN4PXAdxfBrd4pSNSqQToy_JwSFwostokzu8rN06BIU2qvughZ9r5SHxZSWP5qQVIh-UhK_04ayymhNsNpm8jxrEaLIQYg-6Z1Hm3ki1QXA52DmVAcZs-WDJpvOPjCVeG2heXuXRMzp2oa44NJzu07dqUgu2lB2tVN8gTcdfhdQKALuXu91g%3D%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
With only 100 days to go until the election, we must fight back against Russian misinformation

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89742241/488276490/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2MxZmM4NTctMGI0ZC1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=KKz-8l4JxwppEcRJbK6Rry5ZT4-4cMgnHvE0pKwuOYI=&emci=2cb2c851-0b4d-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=cc1fc857-0b4d-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
Peter,

Thank you to Distill Social for rallying Marquette. It was an honor to speak. This is what Democracy looks like.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
I have a primary election in just 9 days. Every contribution from now until election day helps us get out the vote. Thank you for your continued support.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friends,
Yesterday, as a family doctor, social worker, public health medical professional and former diplomat, I offered my insights on Project 2025 at a rally in Marquette, organized by great activists at Distill Social.
Here's a snippet of my statements from yesterday:
"Our founders designed our Democracy so the government would derive its power from 'We, the People.' Yes, we must always demand it improve and better-serve us.
"But, by dismantling this structure, Project 2025 claims to give power to the people; In reality, it leaves the powerful, elite, and ultra-wealthy alone and makes the rest of Americans vulnerable, weak, and divided.
"I call it Project 2024 because it's already happening. But, American Democracy began in the 1700s, and it's not done yet. Saving it, now, that's our project.
Help us save our Democracy. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
-Bob

Democrat, MI01

body:
At the end of this email, I’m going to ask you for a $ donation toward my end-of-month fundraising deadline. But first, I hope you’ll read this
[|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/TU7oL9zyQWJddNZ-e5Ycog~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRoiQ-fP0QgaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZXJpY2ZvcmlsbGlub2lzLmNvbS9XA3NwY0IKZp-miqZm_JxgmVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAABs~)
| | Peter, At the end of this email, I’m going to ask you for a [**$ 10 donation**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/9la0Rp3gXf9_SnovGzfb4A~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRoiQ-fP0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEzLTIwMjQ_) toward my end-of-month fundraising deadline. But first, I hope you’ll read this entire message about what’s at stake and why this request is so important. As I’ve written to you about before, my opponent, Joe McGraw, is a MAGA extremist who said he prayed for the overturn of Roe and spread racist conspiracy theories. So it might not be surprising, but it should be extremely concerning, that at a recent campaign stop he has referred to Democrats as the ‘enemy,’ and invoked the threat of violence to control the government: | **_“So we have to reclaim the land that was taken from us, IL-17 has been taken from us. We must fight to get the land back.

...High seats in government have been tainted by the enemy and we need to take those back.”_**
---
Given the past few weeks, this dangerous, dog-whistling rhetoric has no place in Illinois or America.

body:

In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make your first online donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Arizona.

Hi folks,
Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re reaching out today because we’re just **100 days** away from the most competitive election of our lives in the two most competitive Senate campaigns in the country.
And we need your help.
Montana and Ohio are the only battleground states in the country that won’t see a lot of spending from the top of the ticket. You see, we’re a little different. We’re not the typical politicians you’d expect to see every day in the Senate. One of us is a seven-fingered dirt farmer. The other has been called disheveled, wrinkled, and rumpled. Neither of us are winning any best dressed awards anytime soon.
**But the thing that really sets us apart? We’ll work with anyone to get the job done for our constituents.** And we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home.
But our multimillionaire opponents are trying to buy our Senate seats. Together, we’re going to send them a message: Montana and Ohio are NOT for sale.
We can’t write our campaigns million-dollar checks. But we’ve got something better: you. Our supporters are teachers, electricians, farmers, autoworkers, you name it – who work hard every day to make a living and together, we can make a difference.
We’re building the largest on-the-ground grassroots campaign either state has ever seen because we won’t win this race unless we knock every door and talk to every voter.

| From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Dear Fellow Patriot,

We are witnessing a brutal, unceasing, and deadly assault currently being waged against American families--especially the traditional nuclear family. I'm sure you've felt it.

That's why I launched the American Cornerstone Institute--what I call a "think tank / do tank" -- in order to continue this perilous fight to protect, shore up, and support American families. [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=0eb3c61440d247fe9caa043dd52d2e1d&_e=2YaGXVAGEmjXj-B9kMYaQ439y05_F2qn9TalP453ed4Gdg5mCs8vH-5tFpSFckQGwEXfr3UAQvyuDOKPKQDr4OKJFAHJtEBgmxh29684q0fqNsHp-7wtL8QC8pG9a8VHWARW3K_9OQBF3S4X8RTJHqy4jWfXlaXHo4_22ieyYS2MCjxT7YpLKsly1EIhYgsgBLdh4aQgZd_1CqbixJXH14Jxutg0NCYyYo6ikRMXLd3TEjgJSylvdTWKr-dNr_8U01v83J26d8_tbfEWyHDVPLlC1V8bKOiMH0jq8APNSlI-4uhSEecGDEmbJhYnbDQxvKNeI2UcppaVRyAA0FaKdxf1euuMiwlW7ccjRREia2SVD7AjARrPx39FE_1RhEK9JWrq7iq16KPO9uod2grybw%3D%3D) Your gift of $100 or more to ACI today will help strengthen the bonds of our communities by lifting up the virtues of faith, liberty, community, and life.

Will you give today to support these cornerstone principles? They are essential to the success of our nation--principles that can be bolstered immeasurably and immediately by strengthening our families. To show my appreciation for your gift of $100 or more, you will receive an advanced signed copy of my new book "The Perilous Fight: Overcoming Our Culture's War on the American Family".

And to help pass down these important pillars to the next generation, I'lll also send you a free copy of my children's book "Why America Matters" that celebrates our great country and reminds us what a blessing it is to be an American.

You can make your secure gift here: [https://secure.americancornerstone.org/the-perilous-fight](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=0eb3c61440d247fe9caa043dd52d2e1d&_e=2YaGXVAGEmjXj-B9kMYaQ439y05_F2qn9TalP453ed4Gdg5mCs8vH-5tFpSFckQGwEXfr3UAQvyuDOKPKQDr4OKJFAHJtEBgmxh29684q0fqNsHp-7wtL8QC8pG9a8VHWARW3K_9OQBF3S4X8RTJHqy4jWfXlaXHo4_22ieyYS2MCjxT7YpLKsly1EIhYgsgBLdh4aQgZd_1CqbixJXH14Jxutg0NCYyYo6ikRMXLd3TEjgJSylvdTWKr-dNr_8UBTjorRerydx-6vwZsoyWnPWcqxt1SCaOOopCtbopVVNQnISuhioiZzWlDDdN1Yx5KIiSJ_k1MFDtq7y0pC3vMdjtQ-1R3u3PYPFLYcs-ARwyA3lYYICfkEwlF00348g6dSTib2PNnTVzKB2-R1xh2Q%3D%3D)

Thank you for your interest in preserving and strengthening America's families!

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

| | Congressman Russell Fry, South Carolina’s Seventh Congressional District Congressman, is honored and humbled to represent the Pee Dee and Grand Strand areas in Washington, D.C. Russell Fry is the successful product of the American Dream. He learned from his parents that there is no such thing as a free lunch and that success comes from hard work and determination. Russell self-funded his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina and then earned his law degree at the Charleston School of Law. In law school, he served as Student Bar Association president, helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation, and received the prestigious Civility Award. For over a decade, he practiced law all along the Grand Strand. Russell has always been a public servant and an advocate for the conservative movement. Prior to his election to U.S. Congress, Russell Fry represented Horry County in the South Carolina General Assembly. As Chief Majority Whip in the State House, he fought to lower taxes, defend the unborn, and safeguard the 2nd Amendment. Additionally, Russell fought to put 18 policy initiatives into law in his time as Chairman of the SC House Opioid Abuse Prevention Study Committee. This legislation provided funding for education on opioids, opioid prevention, and opioid treatment. Russell and his wife, Bronwen, have one son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their beloved chocolate lab, Jasper.

Sometimes they’ll even be held to improve the unit for the next tenant, after withholding repairs during the past occupancy. If you didn’t damage anything, you deserve to get it back. It’s as simple as that. My bill, AB 2801, will ensure that you do. As your next representative in Congress, I will bring my experience getting things done for everyday Californians to Washington to make meaningful changes for all Americans - especially those in CA-30. clean_body: | = I wanted to make sure you saw this, friend: My bill to protect security deposits has been highlighted in the Sacramento Bee : = I have seen first-hand in my time in office how renters’ needs are often put behind homeowners, and far, far behind those of landlords. One place that is exploited is the lack of clarity around security deposits. Security deposits can be prohibitively expensive, and tenants’ ability to get them back can vary from landlord to landlord. Sometimes they’ll even be held to improve the unit for the next tenant, after withholding repairs during the past occupancy. If you didn’t damage anything, you deserve to get it back. It’s as simple as that. My bill, AB 2801, will ensure that you do. Ohio is removing nearly 160,000 voters from the rolls, Team.
More than half of Ohio voters who might be purged from the state’s voter rolls are registered in counties where a majority of the population is non-white. Civil rights organizations on the ground say that Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose’s voter purge disproportionately goes after those voters of color.
This is yet another example of partisan elected officials using state law to suppress voters who don't vote for them or their party. The easiest way to secure the results they want is to pick and choose which voters get to count in November.

we will do whatever it takes

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89751103/488305583/-1080040549?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOGIzYWU4NC0yOTRkLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4dolTE16MCcb-8vITAG8c8C2u3yVfesNlU4aNe_5N60=) We’ll get right to it. name: Sarah McBride
subject: Early voting starts in one month!
body:
Thank you, team.
#
Today marks **one month** until early voting begins for the Delaware primary election, which means time is _running out_ to reach undecided voters.
[**Can you pitch in $5 or anything you can spare to help us contact voters up and down Delaware?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240728-1?refcode=em20240728-1&amount=5&refcode2=897_21716_pMxyIi&akid=897%2E21716%2EpMxyIi)
With the support of this grassroots team, I’ve been able to meet neighbors across our state — to ensure that _everyone_ hears our positive message and knows what I’ll fight to deliver in Congress: access to reproductive care, affordable health care and housing, paid family and medical leave, and more.
And grassroots contributions have kept our wonderful organizers and volunteers on the doors and the phones, having one-on-one conversations with voters.
_Thank you, team._
But running for Congress isn’t easy — and it isn’t cheap. To stay on track to reach the voters we need to win the primary and the General Election, we set a goal to raise $20,000 in online donations.
**Team, your $5 will help us recruit a few more volunteers, print extra campaign literature, create another digital ad, and keep me on the campaign trail to reach more voters.**
[**With one month to go until early voting — and 100 days until the November election — can I count on you to chip in to power our campaign today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240728-1?refcode=em20240728-1&amount=5&refcode2=897_21716_pMxyIi&akid=897%2E21716%2EpMxyIi)

Thank you!
Sarah

Fellow American,

I need a special favor from you. More on that in a moment.

First, let me introduce myself and explain why I'm personally reaching out to you. I'm Dave. I've served in the Air Force Reserves' 939th Military Airlift Command, as King County Sheriff, and as a United States Congressman.

I was the lead detective on the tenacious and dedicated investigative team who brought down the monster known as the Green River Killer.

So believe me when I say _I know first-hand the critical importance of having the right team and working together_ when lives are on the line.

Make no mistake. We need real change. The results of this election will are do-or-die.

**That's where you come in:**
I have hundreds of endorsements, but I don't have yours!

Would you do me a huge favor. [**endorse me by clicking here to e-sign your name**](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=1247caa7a68348f8af35d537f77d71f6&_e=65pZ1uM_fQbfX20tQRUZ8pCiS87SYh_8XwNsdbmzzrWnCTlSMny5v-x3VexLHxnYaOC5eLjcCYlPtNLStMiuuZ8lrDBeMCymE9En-BrEjDDuUB1zFPWEc8rta6PJxFvXDo-jdeTDTUGN_wsvJXjbA3lTihwp_RGVesJMj5_cCiFkoRGQ8pdvFzVVyZvR7SKkro7i7UcwWwutykYgUimvCWp2SSNdFbsg8DpLJOtAfVCWSKM79AqewRAzxnSYuMwNdCe5j4wKHJt5Ph3PIPEg-w89jOmkEsiXAFHtfFXV4El7wRuecFEqUiY6pk-4aNcqaoopoHljv5nmsUh1RJlcZcJy4WQMPxh4UkVR-RqYscx4aiMWZ5z1L2Aut0-_Uh8WgSFYQYc-couS1Im9w5itwc4ataRh1w3k_cHFlGisnqQ%3D)?

AND after that, if you can afford it will you chip in $5, $25, or $50 -- I'm on my way to flipping Washington Red after more than 40 years.

I cannot do it alone!

Together, with your help, we'll change what's wrong, fix what's broken, and do what's right.

Dave Reichert

**July 28, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Readers,
In this week's Sunday News Digest, we bring you a detailed account of the recent tumult within the Colorado Republican Party, an episode that vividly illustrates the party's current internal strife and leadership challenges.
This past Saturday, the Colorado Republican Party was set to hold a pivotal Central Committee meeting at Faith Fellowship Church in Brighton to discuss the potential removal of State Chairman Dave Williams, along with his vice-chair and secretary. However, a court order issued just 24 hours before the meeting blocked this gathering, causing significant disruption and preventing any official party business from being conducted. Instead, what was planned as a decisive meeting turned into a "non-meeting rally," where frustrations boiled over in speeches that criticized the current leadership's approach and effectiveness.
The core of the discontent lies in what many see as insufficient support from the state party for Republican candidates, which has been a persistent issue across multiple chairmanships. Senator Barb Kirkmeyer highlighted the dire political strategy as the party holds only 19 of 65 State House seats, despite being close to a supermajority in the Senate. This situation, she argued, is exacerbated by a lack of organizational support, which she feels undermines Republican chances in critical races.
Further intensifying the situation, attendees discussed the potential successors to Williams should a leadership change occur. Prominent figures such as Eli Bremer, Richard Holtorf, and Brita Horn used the rally as a platform to articulate their visions for the party's future, emphasizing the need for robust support for all Republican candidates and a strategic overhaul to enhance party unity and electoral success.
Bremer and Horn, in particular, presented themselves as capable of making immediate, positive changes to the party's financial and strategic woes, with Horn noting her connections to significant donors and Bremer stressing the urgency of competent leadership with the election looming. Meanwhile, Holtorf criticized the current "playbook" and called for a new approach to include a broader spectrum of Republican values and voices.
As the meeting concluded without resolution, the party's deep divisions remained apparent, with calls for a reorganized approach to leadership and strategy moving forward. This incident not only reflects the ongoing challenges within the Colorado Republican Party but also serves as a microcosm of the broader national political dynamics affecting party operations and election strategies.
I had the honor of guest hosting Dan Caplis this week and talked about this subject in depth. [Check out my interviews](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) with State Party Vice-Chairwoman Hope Scheppelman, El Paso County GOP Vice Chair Todd Watkins, and State Party Chair-hopeful Brita Horn.
Warm regards, Heidi Ganahl
---

**[Two new ballot initiatives, for parole eligibility and school choice, submit signatures to secretary of state](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Two more initiatives vying for a spot on the November ballot have submitted signatures to the Secretary of State.
**[Legality of Colorado’s campaign donation limits to be tested by case with Greg Lopez as lead plaintiff](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A federal court judge will decide after the Nov. 5 general election whether Colorado’s state political donation limits for candidates are legal.
**[Gov. Polis would consider VP run with Kamala Harris, if asked, he tells CNN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) If asked, Gov. Jared Polis said he would seriously consider becoming the vice-presidential candidate behind Vice President Kamala Harris, who is working to secure the official Democratic nomination for president in 2024.
_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[Anti-Israel agitators burn American flags, accuse Netanyahu of being ‘war criminal’ as he addresses Congress](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Anti-Israel demonstrators descended on Washington, D.C., on Wednesday ahead of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s address to Congress.

**[FACT CHECK: Harris was Biden’s second ‘border czar,’ despite recent media claims](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE CENTER SQUARE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) As Vice President Kamala Harris began campaigning to become the next Democratic presidential nominee, media outlets started claiming she was never President Joe Biden’s border czar.
**[Trump indeed was struck by would-be assassin’s bullet in Butler, Penn., FBI says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [POLITICO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Nearly two weeks after Donald Trump’s near assassination, the FBI confirmed Friday that it was indeed a bullet that struck the former president’s ear, moving to clear up conflicting accounts about what caused the former president’s injuries after a gunman opened fire at a Pennsylvania rally.
**[Former President Barack and First Lady Michelle Obama endorse Harris bid for President](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [POLITICO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Former President Barack Obama and former first lady Michelle Obama threw their support behind Vice President Kamala Harris’ bid for the White House on Friday.
**[Bidenomics: Housing costs hitting record highs, Harvard University report says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX BUSINESS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The high cost of housing is making it hard for many Americans to make ends meet, and monthly rents are rising faster than wages, according to a new housing report from Harvard University.

**LOCAL**
**[Mesa County counters proposal for 400,000-acre ‘monument’ with 30,000-acre proposal for Dolores River](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Mesa County has countered the call for a national monument around the Dolores River with plans for a much smaller national conservation area.
**[Police: In Westminster, burglars are surveilling business owners before breaking into their homes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Westminster police are warning the public about a growing burglary trend in which small business owners are being targeted at their homes.
**[Reworded ballot measure to lift pit-bull ban passed forward by Aurora Council](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Aurora councilmembers passed a resolution to put a re-worded question regarding the ownership of pit bulls on the November ballot.
**[Tony May faces Garfield School Board recall; accused of bullying, other claims](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [POST INDEPENDENT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Former Garfield Re-2 School Board President Tony May is facing a recall election on Aug. 27. Last year, May led efforts to implement American Birthright Standards, which ultimately failed to gain approval from the board after facing significant resistance from community members and district personnel. Organizers of the recall petition that followed accused May of bullying community members and Re-2 staff members, misusing his position and more.
**_[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**

Jared Polis of Ukraine war funding an indicator he is eyeing the DNC presidential ticket?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _The United States’ continued funding of the Ukraine-Russia war is set to be a key issue in the 2024 presidential race, raising questions about whether Colorado Gov. Jared Polis is positioning himself for a spot on the Democratic National Convention’s presidential ticket._
__
**[York: Joe Biden owes the country an explanation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _President Joe Biden is scheduled to make a live address to the nation tonight at 9 p.m. That is a violation of his plan “to stop scheduling events after 8 p.m. so that he can get more sleep,” according to news reports earlier this month when he was still struggling to hold on to the Democratic nomination. But it is extremely important that he stay up and tell the public what is going on._
**[Swearer: Why the 2nd Amendment is more crucial than ever after attempt to kill Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY SIGNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _A 20-year-old man with a rifle, perched atop a nearby roof, fired several rounds July 13 at Donald Trump as the former president spoke at a campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, killing one attendee and wounding at least two others._

Joe Biden has served our nation for _over fifty years_. He's seen us through some of America's darkest moments and highest triumphs. body:
Your inbox is probably full of campaign emails right now. I want to take a moment to explain why Truth to Power is different.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39005%2E3422442%2EWdfHFJ)
Derek—it's Katie Porter.
We’re a few months away from a critical election day. That probably means that your inbox is full of fundraising emails from campaigns, candidates, and committees from across the country.
I’m sure some of them are good, ethical emails. But I’m also sure that some of them are... a little sketchy.
**As a consumer protection attorney, there’s a lot I’ve always disliked about political emails** —which is why we’ve never sent you anything about a bogus “3x match” or any fake math about the “5 donors we **NEED** from your zip code _right now._ ”
Maybe the worst offenders are the emails that try to scare or intimidate you into donating. Often, they’re sent by groups you’ve never heard of before, with names chock-full of buzzwords like “democracy” or “victory” or “America.”
These groups are rarely transparent about who they are or how they spend your money. Sometimes, they’re “scam PACs,” which is a type of political organization that claims to support important causes but actually funnels donations into consultants’ pockets. I hate scam PACs.
**I want to take a moment to explain why Truth to Power isn't like that.** We’re not an amorphous void, where your money disappears untraceably and somehow saves democracy.
Truth to Power is a specific organization, with a specific goal. We endorse candidates for Congress who will champion the fight against corporate money in politics once elected.
We use your contributions to support their campaigns, fighting back against interference from dark money groups. Too often, candidates who refuse to accept money from corporate interests lose their races because they cannot close the fundraising gap with their corporate-backed opponents. **Truth to Power exists to stop that from happening.**
In just over five months, my time in Congress will come to an end. But, our movement is far from over—with your help, we will elect leaders who will build on my work, carrying on the fight against special interests and corporate influence in the halls of power.
Election day is getting closer, and our fight is ramping up. **[So, if you can, please consider making a contribution to Truth to Power today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240728?refcode=em20240728-39005&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39005_3422442_WdfHFJ&akid=39005%2E3422442%2EWdfHFJ)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240728?refcode=em20240728-39005&refcode2=39005_3422442_WdfHFJ&akid=39005%2E3422442%2EWdfHFJ)
Thanks for reading, and thanks for supporting our work. I am honored to have you in my corner.
—Katie

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240728-39005&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=39005_3422442_WdfHFJ&akid=39005%2E3422442%2EWdfHFJ)**
